source_name: Enhetsregisteret — Central Coordinating Register for Legal Entities (entities)
record_shape: json_object_per_entity (HAL); list endpoint wraps in _embedded.enheter[]; bulk is gzip JSON array or flattened CSV (dot notation)

fields.meaning: 9-digit Norwegian organisation number; the national company identifier (mod-11 checksum).
fields.limitations: Numeric but must be kept as a string to preserve leading zeros.
fields.analysis_notes: Primary key and the join key for Regnskapsregisteret and roller.

fields.meaning: Current registered legal name of the entity.
fields.limitations: Stored uppercase by the register; no historical names in this endpoint.
fields.analysis_notes: Primary display name.

fields.meaning: Legal form code (org form).
fields.analysis_notes: ASA=public ltd, AS=private ltd, ENK=sole proprietor, NUF=Norwegian-registered foreign enterprise.

fields.meaning: Human-readable legal form name.
Primary industry/activity code (SN2007, the Norwegian NACE Rev.2 implementation).
fields.limitations: Some entities have no industry code.
fields.analysis_notes: naeringskode2 and naeringskode3 hold secondary codes with the same shape.

fields.meaning: Primary industry description.
Secondary industry code+description (object with kode/beskrivelse).
fields.limitations: Present only when a second activity is registered.

fields.meaning: Tertiary industry code+description.
fields.limitations: Rare.

fields.meaning: Auxiliary unit (helping function) code; present in bulk CSV columns.
fields.limitations: Not present in the entity API sample; observed as CSV columns hjelpeenhetskode.kode/.beskrivelse.
fields.analysis_notes: Marks units that only support other units.

fields.meaning: Registered employee count.
fields.limitations: Only set when harRegistrertAntallAnsatte is true; sourced from NAV Aa-registeret.

fields.meaning: Whether an employee count is registered.
Self-reported website/homepage.
fields.limitations: Free text; not validated, no scheme; can be stale.
fields.analysis_notes: Useful for domain/website discovery in the wider platform.

fields.meaning: Self-reported phone number.
fields.limitations: Free text formatting.
fields.analysis_notes: mobil and epostadresse are sibling contact fields (epostadresse only in bulk CSV).

fields.meaning: Self-reported contact email.
fields.limitations: Observed as a bulk CSV column; not present in the entity API sample.
fields.analysis_notes: Personal data possible (e.g. for sole proprietors) — handle per GDPR.

fields.meaning: Business (visiting) address street lines.
fields.limitations: Array of lines; join with newline/space.
fields.analysis_notes: forretningsadresse is the principal business location.

fields.meaning: Business address postal code.
Business address postal town.
Municipality name of the business address.
Official municipality number (kommunenummer) of the business address.
fields.analysis_notes: First 2 digits historically map to county (fylke); derive region from this.

fields.meaning: ISO country code of the business address.
Mailing address (same shape as forretningsadresse).
fields.limitations: Often a PO box; may differ from business address.

fields.meaning: Institutional sector classification code (SSB).
fields.analysis_notes: e.g. 1120 = state-owned limited companies.

fields.meaning: Date the entity was founded/incorporated.
fields.limitations: Not present for all forms.
fields.analysis_notes: Best 'incorporation_date'; fall back to registreringsdatoEnhetsregisteret.

fields.meaning: Date registered in the Central Coordinating Register.
fields.limitations: CSV column casing differs (registreringsdatoenhetsregisteret).

fields.meaning: Whether the entity is registered in the VAT register (MVA).
fields.limitations: CSV column casing differs (registrertIMvaRegisteret).
fields.analysis_notes: When true, VAT id = NO{orgnr}MVA.

fields.meaning: Whether registered in Foretaksregisteret (the legally constitutive register for commercial entities).
fields.analysis_notes: registreringsdatoForetaksregisteret holds the date.

fields.meaning: Registered in the foundations register.
Registered in the register of non-profit/voluntary organisations.
Registered in the register of political parties.
Year of the most recently submitted annual accounts.
fields.limitations: Year only.
fields.analysis_notes: Cheap signal to trigger/refresh a Regnskapsregisteret fetch; cache financials keyed on this value.

fields.meaning: Whether the entity is in bankruptcy.
fields.analysis_notes: konkursdato (CSV) holds the date when set.

fields.meaning: Whether the entity is under voluntary liquidation.
fields.analysis_notes: underAvviklingDato (CSV) holds the date.

fields.meaning: Whether under compulsory liquidation/dissolution.
fields.analysis_notes: Several tvangs* date columns in CSV detail the reason (missing CEO/auditor/accounts/board).

fields.meaning: Org number of the parent/superior entity (for group/branch linkage).
fields.limitations: Present mainly on sub-entities and group children; not on Equinor sample.
fields.analysis_notes: Join key back to enheter.

fields.meaning: Whether the entity is part of a corporate group (konsern).
fields.limitations: Boolean only; the group members are not enumerated here.

fields.meaning: Registered share capital amount.
fields.limitations: Present mainly for AS/ASA; not in CSV/all forms. (Observed in entity API sample.)
fields.analysis_notes: kapital also has antallAksjer, type, valuta, innfortDato.

fields.meaning: Currency of the share capital.
Official Norwegian language form used by the entity (Bokmål/Nynorsk).
Purpose of the entity as stated in its articles of association.
example_values: ["Å utvikle, produsere og markedsføre ulike former for energi..."]
fields.limitations: Array of text lines (line-wrapped); join to reconstruct.

fields.meaning: Free-text description of the entity's activity.
example_values: ["Selv, eller gjennom deltakelse i eller sammen med andre selskaper å utvikle..."]
fields.limitations: Array of text lines.
